title: Reconditioning Parts List of a Returned PAP Therapy Equipment Unit
content:
# Reconditioning Parts List of a Returned PAP Therapy Equipment Unit

**Rule.** The reconditioning parts of a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit returned to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request are booked on its return inspection at Summit Ridge list price. The parts start from the filter set fitted to every returned unit, listed at **7.50 USD**, and the internal air-path kit, chosen by the days from the delivery date on the device record to the date the completed return pickup request records the unit as received back:

| Days from delivery to receipt | Air-path kit | List price (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| more than 14 | full air-path kit | 18.00 |
| more than 7 and up to 14 | half kit | 9.00 |
| 7 or less | none | 0.00 |

The parts list is the sum of the filter set and the air-path kit, booked to the cent.

**Counting the days.** The receipt date is the decision date of the completed return pickup request. The days are calendar days from the delivery date to that date, the delivery date itself not counted: a unit received back the day after delivery counts 1 day.

## Worked examples (hypothetical dates)

- Delivered 3 June, received back 9 June: 6 days, no kit; parts list 7.50.
- Delivered 3 June, received back 13 June: 10 days, half kit; parts list 7.50 plus 9.00, or 16.50.
- Delivered 3 June, received back 25 June: 22 days, full kit; parts list 7.50 plus 18.00, or 25.50.

## Both sides of each line

| Days | Kit |
|---|---|
| 7 | none |
| 8 | half kit |
| 14 | half kit |
| 15 | full air-path kit |

**Point of judgement.** *Is the filter set fitted to every class?* Yes; it is fitted to every returned unit, whatever its class.
